subject: Vendor portal sync — MSA / Order Form redlines and supplier registration
messages:
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@globex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier registration & MSA redline questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to reach out to start supplier setup and to surface a couple of contract items before we move into our vendor portal. A few things on their checklist: 

- Which procurement portals do you support for supplier registration? (we use Ariba as standard, but some LoBs use Coupa)
- Does Redwood require a signed MSA + Order Form before a supplier record can be created? Our ops team prefers to create the supplier first so POs can be issued ASAP.
- Payment terms: are you able to accept Net45 / PO-based invoicing?
- Any special billing remit addresses or tax forms we should expect on invoices?

Procurement also asked if you can ingest redlines in Word/PDF so we can handle approvals in Ariba — we will upload to the system once we have a draft. Attaching our onboarding checklist for reference.

Can you confirm next steps and who from Redwood will own the registration? Happy to set a short call to walk procurement through your supplier packet.

Thanks,
Sara Lee
Procurement Manager — Globex Corporation
procurements@globex.com
Attachment: Globex_Supplier_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & MSA redline questions

Sara — thanks for the note and the checklist, really helpful. 

Quick answers up front: we support both Ariba and Coupa supplier flows; we can register in Ariba but procurement needs us to provide the following to complete the supplier record: Redwood legal name, TAX/EIN, remit address, and a copy of a signed W-9 (or equivalent).

Regarding contract timing: our standard practice is to complete an MSA + Order Form before services begin, but we can start supplier onboarding in the portal ahead of signature to accelerate PO issuance — we just need to coordinate acceptance of POs against a pending Order Form. 

Payment terms: our commercial standard is Net30; Net45 is possible on a case-by-case basis for enterprise accounts — I will loop in Marissa from Legal to review redlines.

Next steps I propose: 
- Marissa to review any MSA redlines you upload.
- Lauren will own vendor ops/portal questions and can confirm the exact Ariba/Coupa onboarding artifact we should supply.
- I’ll share our clean MSA and a redline from our side so procurement can see baseline changes.

I’ve attached the clean MSA for now (PDF). If you can share your redline file in Word or PDF we’ll review and aim to return comments within 48 business hours. Happy to schedule a 30-min call if that helps.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_clean.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & MSA redline questions

Karthik / Lauren,

I reviewed Sara’s checklist and did a first-pass on likely redlines. Highlights / guidance: 

1) Payment terms — change to Net45 is acceptable if procurement provides a PO binding against the Order Form and includes the PO number on the invoice. We should insist on explicit language in the Order Form that binds POs to the agreed pricing and term sheet.
2) Indemnity & Data — Globex has historically pushed for broad third-party indemnity and long retention clauses. We should push back and limit indemnity to IP infringement and willful misconduct and cap consequential damages as per Redwood standard.
3) Audit / SOC 2 requests — we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and a summary of data handling; any additional audit requests should be scoped, costed, and handled through a separate SOW.
4) Acceptance & SOW language — ensure the Order Form references the service description and target throughput/SLAs so PO reviewers have line-of-sight in Ariba.

I’m attaching a PDF with inline redlines and a redlined Order Form template. If Juncture procurement uploads their tracked-changes Word doc, I can incorporate and prepare a redline-ready Word copy that is Ariba-friendly.

If they still require supplier creation before signature, we should get a written confirmation from procurement that the supplier record is provisional pending fully executed Order Form; that avoids accidental auto-POs without an executed commercial document.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_karthik_redlines.pdf; OrderForm_template_redline.docx
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@globex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@globex.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2026 07:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & MSA redline questions

Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. We uploaded our tracked changes of the MSA and the Order Form to Ariba (you should see an upload under GLX-7721). Our Ariba supplier ID is GLX-SUP-7721. For a couple of clarifications: 

- Some of our business units use Coupa and will require a separate supplier invitation (we’ll ask those teams to reuse the same supplier ID where possible).
- Procurement can create a provisional supplier record with a note that the legal team must finalize the MSA and Order Form. That should let us issue POs for SOW prep (no billable services until executed).
- Attached is our PO requirements doc — it lists required invoice fields, PO number placement, remit address and tax documentation.

We’d like to run a short sync on Wed to confirm who will upload the final docs into Ariba and to confirm invoicing workflow (PO vs invoice-first). Would 30 minutes at 10am PT work?

Regards,
Sara Lee
Procurement Manager — Globex Corporation
Attachment: Globex_PO_requirements.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & MSA redline questions

Sara — 10am PT on Wed works for me. Lauren — can you take point on the portal upload (Ariba / Coupa) and confirm which artifacts procurement will need from us? I’ll take ownership of the contract path and ensure Marissa has the Word tracked-change file to finalize redlines.

Practical checklist I’ll action before the call: 
- Provide Redwood supplier dossier (W-9, EIN, remit address) and a clean redline Word of the MSA.
- Confirm whether we can accept Net45 for this account and, if so, add the payment term exception to the Order Form.
- Share the Coupa supplier invite link and an internal onboarding packet (we have a short PDF I’ll upload).

Links for the call: Ariba upload (https://supplier.ariba.com/registration/GLX-7721) and Coupa onboarding doc attached. Please confirm attendee list for Wed and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: Coupa_Onboarding_Steps.pdf
